name: test-design-system
description: Test Design System: documentation (Storybook) and the React component library, sourced from the AEGL AUG Design Library in Figma.

scripts.prepare:docs: npm run icons:build && npm run tokens && npm run docs:generate && npm run sidebar
scripts.build-storybook:html:pages: npm run prepare:docs && storybook build -c .storybook-pages -o storybook-html-static
scripts.storybook:react: npm run icons:build && npm run tokens && storybook dev -p 6007 -c .storybook-react
scripts.build-storybook:react: npm run icons:build && npm run tokens && storybook build -c .storybook-react -o storybook-static-react
scripts.build-storybook:react:pages: npm run icons:build && npm run tokens && storybook build -c .storybook-react-pages -o storybook-react-static
scripts.build:pages: npm run build-storybook:react:pages && npm run build-storybook:html:pages && node scripts/assemble-pages-dist.mjs
scripts.build:lib: npm run icons:build && npm run tokens && vite build -c vite.lib.config.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/build-lib-assets.mjs
